actions.label: Track LOCK
actions.description: Lock the target: the detector's relock candidate if one is shown, otherwise the centre of the image (point the camera at it first)

actions.label: GO (default)
actions.description: ONE press: GO now (with --go-confirm: 1st press arms and shows distance/ETA, 2nd within 3 s confirms). Uses the tracker's --go-speed and --go-offset (default: to the target)

actions.label: GO 5 m/s, stop 3 m short
actions.description: GO at 5 m/s, stopping 3 m before the target. One press.

actions.label: GO, stop 10 m past
actions.description: GO at the configured speed, over the target, stopping 10 m PAST it (param2 = -10). One press.

actions.label: GO fast 8 m/s, at target
actions.description: GO at 8 m/s to the target (param1 = speed m/s, param2 = stop offset m: + before the target, - past it; 0 = configured). One press.

actions.label: ABORT (climb away)
actions.description: Leave the target and climb (--abort-climb, default 10 m), then hold in GUIDED

actions.label: Track UNLOCK
actions.description: Drop the target lock and stop following

actions.label: BRAKE
actions.description: Panic button: stop the companion's go-to and switch the vehicle to BRAKE
